items.claim: Helpline documents CVE-2017-9362 as a route from an authenticated user to elevated privileges, and the authoritative record confirms the same weakness in the affected product.
items.body:
HTB machine Helpline (official write-up, doc 180, 37202 chars, sha1 b917aad15b86) describes CVE-2017-9362. Mechanism as documented on the machine: The XML payload to read the file would be , <!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///C:\Temp\Password Audit\it_logins.txt"> ]>< A PI version=' 1.0' l ocale= ' en'>

Authoritative record: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 9312 contains an XML injection at add Configuration items CMDB API.
items.disproof: Refuted when the running product is outside the affected version range, or when the specific weakness (CVE-2017-9362) is patched on the target: the documented escalation then does not exist, whatever the advisory still says.

sources.quote: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 9312 contains an XML injection at add Configuration items CMDB API.
CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

evidence.note: HTB official write-up (retired machine). The public machine page is a login-gated SPA and does not carry this text, so the quote is verifiable only against this document.
